name: Orchestra Layout
description:
Named performer positions for a standard string ensemble formation, for use as Source/Receiver positions.

Options:
- string_quartet (4 players)
- chamber_strings (16 players)
- chamber_strings_24 (24 players)
- symphonic_strings_50 (50 players)

inputParameters.name: plane
inputParameters.description: Plane the layout is built on. Defaults to WorldXY if omitted.
